topic: How does defocused reflector gain loss impact link budget margins for SNR compared to conventional designs?
consensus_response: Defocused reflectors reduce peak gain, impacting SNR margins, but offer resilience to feed element failures. Adaptive beamforming mitigates losses by optimizing signal direction and shape, enhancing effective gain and maintaining SNR. Design trade-offs balance reliability and performance, considering additional elements or curved arrays to compensate for gain loss.
reference_context: Defocused reflectors suffer 1.5-1.7 dB gain loss, with increased spillover losses, affecting SNR margins and link budget performance.
